### This competition will be part of the AssoKappa yearly convention. Please read *carefully* the [Registration tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AKMeetsSpeedcubing2022#18226-registration-registrazione) and the [AssoKappa Convention tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AKMeetsSpeedcubing2022#18593-assokappa-convention-raduno-assokappa).

**Note: you will have to pay €10 extra at the venue if you are not a Cubing Italy member.
Becoming a member is free! discover how in the [Registration tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AKMeetsSpeedcubing2022#18226-registration-registrazione).**

---
### Questa competizione sarà parte del raduno annuale di AssoKappa. Perfavore leggete *attentamente*  la [tab Registratione](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AKMeetsSpeedcubing2022#18226-registration-registrazione) e la [tab Raduno AssoKappa](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AKMeetsSpeedcubing2022#18593-assokappa-convention-raduno-assokappa).

**Nota: dovrai pagare altri €10 in loco se non ti associ a Cubing Italy.
Associarsi è gratis! scopri come nella [sezione Registrazione](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AKMeetsSpeedcubing2022#18226-registration-registrazione).**
